title: Mucha Documentary
content: (Video link) This six-part video about Czech-French artist Alphonse Mucha documents his rise as a poster artist, his voyage to America, his gigantic Slav Epics, and his long-lasting influence as a designer.Episode 2Episode 3(at 7:40, a glimpse of his sketchbooks)Episode 4(at :50, an explanation of his gridding and tracing)Episode 5(at :57, a view of his personal pastels, never exhibited until the 1990s.)Episode 6
